import sys, sqlite3

def attempt(label, fn):
    try:
        fn(); print(f"  [FAIL] {label} —— 竟然写进去了")
    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
        print(f"  [ok]   {label} → IntegrityError: {exc}")

def allow(label, fn):
    try:
        fn(); conn.rollback(); print(f"  [ok]   {label} → 放行（符合预期）")
    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as exc:
        print(f"  [FAIL] {label} → 被拦：{exc}")

    try:

attempt("删除仍被 accounts.bound_ip_id 引用的出口", lambda: conn.execute("DELETE FROM ips WHERE id=1"))

class FakePage:
    def __init__(self, behaviour): self.behaviour = behaviour; self.closed = False
    def goto(self, url, wait_until=None):
        if self.behaviour == "boom": raise RuntimeError(f"net::ERR 登录墙 detail?code=SECRET&goods_id=1")
        return None
    def wait_for_selector(self, sel, timeout=None):
        if self.behaviour == "timeout": raise TimeoutError(f"等待 {sel} 超时")
        return object()
    def evaluate(self, js):
        if self.behaviour == "blocked": return {"ok": False, "price_text": None, "errors": ["price: all selectors missed", "系统繁忙"]}
        return {"ok": True, "price_text": "¥ 39.9", "errors": []}
    def close(self): self.closed = True
class FakeCtx:
    def __init__(self, behaviour): self.behaviour = behaviour
    def new_page(self): return FakePage(self.behaviour)
class FakeLauncher:
    def __init__(self, behaviour="ok", counter=None): self.behaviour = behaviour; self.opens = 0; self.counter = counter
    def open(self, lease):
        self.opens += 1
        if self.counter is not None: self.counter[0] = self.behaviour if self.behaviour != "ok" else "ok"
        return FakeCtx("ok") if self.behaviour == "ok" else FakeCtx(self.behaviour)
    def close(self): pass
